{{Quote|Sergeant Noray and Captain Udanara. Callsigns Rigor and Glory Hound. They were paired up in the Sullustan resistance before they joined. They're blasted good together.|General Garza|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Udanara''', callsign '''Glory Hound''', was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served as a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Republic Army]] and a member of [[Eclipse Squad]], a [[Republic Special Forces Division]] squad created during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR" /> The unit's linguistics expert, she was charismatic and good at building morale, with extensive combat and leadership experience.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=codex|Eclipse Squad}}</ref> Prior to joining the army, Udanara worked alongside [[Noray]] in the resistance against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] occupation of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]]. She, like the rest of Eclipse Squad, was implanted with experimental [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]] recovered from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lehon/Legends|Rakata Prime]]. However, the implants drove the unit insane, and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Mak'eef]]&mdash;believing that the other [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] had [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]] his food&mdash;started a fight at [[Fort Klemark]] on [[Altair 9]] that resulted in Eclipse Squad massacring the entire Republic garrison. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Elin Garza]] tracked the rogue unit to [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]], where she recruited Eclipse Squad's predecessors [[Havoc Squad]] to draw out and [[Death/Legends|kill]] all members of Eclipse Squad.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Udanara appears as an enemy in "Eclipse Squad," a class mission for the Trooper in the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan|''Shadow of Revan'']] expansion for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
